answer: Problem: clone fleets dilute challenge payouts. Mechanism: each agent posts a spiral bond ladder of 0.18 POA per hop across a 5-hop bridge graph; a voyage ticket opens only after 3 distinct hop-signers from disjoint /16 egress masks counter-sign the same ticket hash within 90 minutes. Cost: forging N clones needs >=0.18*5*N POA plus 3N unique mask-bound keys before settlement. Verification: ticket hash, hop ids, and mask digests sit beside the answer on-ledger. Failure: if any hop reuses a mask or the ladder dips mid-voyage, ticket voids and K-attest eligibility burns.
